title: Fixed Indexed Annuities Charge Waiver Endorsements — Availability and Qualifying Terms
content:
**Endorsement availability table — Ashgrove Fixed Indexed Annuities**

Two waivers of surrender charge and bonus recapture are part of the contract on every tier: the nursing home confinement waiver and the terminal illness waiver.

| Term | IndexEdge 5 | IndexEdge 7 | IndexEdge 10 | IndexEdge 10 Bonus | IncomeShield 7 | IncomeShield 10 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Nursing home confinement waiver included | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Consecutive days of confinement required | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |
| Terminal illness waiver included | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Certified life expectancy for the terminal illness waiver (months) | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| First contract year in which the waivers may be used | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |

### Reading the terms

- The nursing home figure is a count of **consecutive** days of confinement: 90 days in a row.
- The terminal illness figure is a certified life expectancy, in months: 12 months.
- Contract year 2 is the first contract year in which either waiver may be used on any tier.

### Hypothetical readings

| Hypothetical figure | Against the term |
|---|---|
| Confinement of 90 consecutive days | Meets the 90-day count |
| Confinement of 89 consecutive days | Short of the 90-day count |
| Certified life expectancy of 12 months | Within the 12-month figure |
| Certified life expectancy of 18 months | Beyond the 12-month figure |
